title: Enter therapeutic goods in the ARTG before supplying them
what: Therapeutic goods for use in humans must be registered, listed or included in the Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods (or exempt or approved) before they are imported, exported, manufactured or supplied.

sources.title: Therapeutic Goods Act 1989
sources.quote: (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person: (i) imports into Australia therapeutic goods for use in humans; or (ii) exports from Australia therapeutic goods for use in humans; or (iii) manufactures in Australia therapeutic goods for use in humans; or (iv) supplies in Australia therapeutic goods for use in humans;

reach.condition: if it imports, manufactures or supplies therapeutic goods for use in humans

assessment.summary: Medicines and devices must be assessed and entered in the ARTG, with fees and annual charges, before supply.

marks.reason: A product cannot be imported or supplied until it is in the ARTG, after evaluation and fees.
Evaluation times and evidence requirements are a hurdle for new products.
Annual charges, adverse event reporting and advertising rules.
